warning.titlePre: Jaguar XE D165 Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: If your XE D165 has the Ingenium AJ200D diesel engine — that's the 2.0-litre four-cylinder unit fitted to the X760 generation — timing chain and injector seal wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages. We replace the timing chain, injectors, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
The petrol XE variants use different engines (the AJ200 petrol Ingenium), which don't share this specific diesel timing chain issue — they're a separate fuel system with their own characteristics.
warning.source: Source: widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages, per VRF-jaguar-xe.md. Petrol Ingenium variants explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to diesel application.
